Players Committee card image of [[FN-2199 (Nines) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “During battle with a stormtrooper, may cancel one opponent's just drawn automated or lightsaber weapon destiny. Permanent weapon is Z6 Riot Control Baton (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target hit if destiny > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/fn2199nines.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1d114e11aef35680bc775029d4203d1eae714fad 1d114e1] (11 July 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
